t: Variable Valve Actuation (VVA)
s: Variable Valve Actuation (VVA) or Valve-Event Modulation (VEM) are general terms that can be used to describe a range of technologies used to add flexibility to the engine’s valve train by enabling variable valve event timing, duration and/or lift.

t: Vietnam Veterans of America's 'Recycling' Program, Debunked! | CharityWatch
s: November 22, 2024 - In its audit, VVA refers to the costs associated with collecting “discarded household items and automobiles from the community” to be a “Recycling Program.” It subtracts these costs from the revenue it generates from selling these donated items to “contracted private companies.” Therefore, these costs do not show up in VVA’s reported fundraising and total expenses.
